svg.title: ANULUM — complete named-project atlas, work in progress
svg.desc: Every named source project and component appears as a separate entry. Group containers indicate catalogue responsibility. Technical relations are separate and source-bound. All work is in progress; release availability and qualification remain separate facts.

g.title: DIRECTOR-AI: Response-level guardrail for LLM output: NLI and retrieval grounding, sealed evidence packets and an optional streaming contradiction halt. Released software · ongoing development Licence: Apache-2.0 AND BUSL-1.1

REMANENTIA: Local-first, auditable memory for AI agents and knowledge-intensive software: project-file indexing, hybrid retrieval, consolidation and an entity graph, through a CLI, an MCP server and an HTTP API. Released software · ongoing development Licence: AGPL-3.0-or-later

RIGOR-FOUNDRY: Evidence-bound repository auditing: inventories Git-tracked content, emits reproducible audit candidates, binds review decisions to exact evidence and prepares remediation inputs. Released software · ongoing development Licence: Apache-2.0

SYNAPSE-CHANNEL: Local-first coordination bus for AI agents: presence, file-scope work claims, messages, task status, receipts and an audit journal on one hub. Released software · ongoing development Licence: AGPL-3.0-or-later

HushLine: Local command-output filter: runs a command, then limits, shapes and redacts its output before it reaches a caller. Four independent cores: Go, Rust, Python and Node. Released software · ongoing development Licence: AGPL-3.0-or-later

SCPN-QUANTUM-CONTROL: Integrated modelling, simulation, compilation, gradients, control, provider workflows, analysis and Quantum Studio. Released software · ongoing development Licence: AGPL-3.0-or-later
oscillatools: Classical coupled-phase-oscillator dynamics, observables, sensitivities and control-oriented numerical tools. Released software · ongoing development Licence: AGPL-3.0-or-later
scpn-quantum-engine: Optional Rust/PyO3 numerical acceleration and native computation used by supported workbench paths. Released software · ongoing development Licence: AGPL-3.0-or-later

SCPN-QC-AD: Whole-program automatic differentiation, derivative transforms, batching, optimisation and explicit supported-path contracts. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release
SCPN-QC-ANALYSIS: Observables, synchronisation witnesses, result analysis and the open-data DLA-parity pathway. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release
SCPN-QC-APPS: Domain application adapters, quantum randomness, cryptography and sensing workflows, with explicit claim boundaries. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release
SCPN-QC-BENCH: Workload-specific benchmark suites, comparison harnesses, campaign reproduction and retained run evidence. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release
SCPN-QC-COMPILER: Model and circuit frontends, intermediate representations, interchange and code generation. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release

g.title: SCPN-QC-CONTROL: Feedback and co-design, chimera and topology-aware control, and DLA-constrained control paths. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release

SCPN-QC-CORE: Configuration, logging, resource budgets and generic Kuramoto-XY problem foundations, separated from paper-specific research assumptions. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release
SCPN-QC-HAL: Provider-neutral workloads, capabilities, job/result contracts and optional provider adapters. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release
SCPN-QC-LEARN: Forecasting, quantum neural models, surrogate models, kernels and variational learning paths. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release
SCPN-QC-MITIGATION: Error-mitigation implementations and their method taxonomy. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release
SCPN-QC-QEC: Quantum error-correction analysis and fault-tolerant resource-reporting surfaces. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release

SCPN-QC-QNODE: Quantum tapes, gradient execution and framework bridges for supported Qiskit, PennyLane, JAX, PyTorch and TensorFlow paths. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release
SCPN-QC-RESEARCH: Experimental SCPN theory, paper-specific assumptions and research adapters whose contracts are not stable. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release

SCPN-QC-SIM: Classical and quantum oscillator dynamics, XY/Kuramoto solvers, open-system simulation, tensor-network paths and co-simulation. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release
SCPN-QC-STUDIO: Quantum Studio's visual workflows, inspectors and evidence presentation through the shared Studio platform contract. Workbench transition Licence: Undecided for independent release

GRADIENT-WITNESS: Check software derivatives against declared analytic, parameter-shift and finite-difference references, including complex, finite-shot and cross-framework cases. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release

g.aria-label: EVIDENCE-MANIFEST-TOOLKIT In progress · Contents are not published. Licence: Not stated (repository not published)
g.title: EVIDENCE-MANIFEST-TOOLKIT: Intended purpose: canonicalises, references, seals and verifies evidence with explicit schemas, bounded sources and independently selected policy. Contents are not published. Licence: Not stated (repository not published)
g.text: In progress · Contents are not published.

g.title: EXPERIMENT-LEDGER: Records experiment lineage across tools without owning their raw evidence or running their computations. Design and preparation Licence: undecided
RANDOMNESS-WITNESS: Assesses number-source suitability for a declared stochastic-computing use; it does not certify randomness for every purpose. Design and preparation Licence: undecided
AER-LINK-WITNESS: Measures event-link behaviour under load, including loss, reordering, fairness, starvation and forward progress. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release

BITSTREAM-EVIDENCE-CI: Captures pinned FPGA build inputs, reports and bitstream identity in a reproducibility-aware chained build ledger. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release
DEPLOY-PACK: Composes validated deployment evidence with bitstream/driver identity into a verifiable install/update package. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release
FIELD-OPS-WITNESS: Aggregates compact field health and drift evidence against deployment-time envelopes without actuating devices. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release
FLIGHT-RECORDER: Retains a bounded per-device event/state history for gap-honest incident reconstruction. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release

LOOP-TIMING-WITNESS: Fabric-clock instrument for complete control-loop and selected accelerator timing, with simulation/host analysis separated from eventual board timing, fault response and rail-energy evidence. Architecture and qualification Licence: AGPL-3.0-or-later

MODEL-PROVENANCE-PACK: Binds a model's data, training, conversion, quantisation, encoding and supporting evidence into a verifiable provenance pack. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release
MUTATION-SNN: Measures test adequacy by generating declared semantic mutants and recording what the suite detects. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release
NEURO-EVIDENCE-BENCH: Executes declared neuromorphic benchmark plans and traces each scoped result back to its raw evidence. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release
NEURO-SAFETY-CASE: Composes scoped evidence and open gaps into an assessor-facing assurance argument; it certifies nothing itself. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release

NIR-CONFORMANCE: Tests importer/exporter behaviour against the known semantics of a pinned Neuromorphic Intermediate Representation version. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release

PLASTICITY-WITNESS: Compares observed learning-rule updates with an independently defined fixed-point or statistical oracle under stated spike/load/fault protocols. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release

RELIABILITY-WITNESS: Characterises reliability within a declared physical or explicitly simulated exposure, retaining conditions, gaps and rare-event uncertainty. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release

SC-STREAM-PROVER: Compares realised stochastic-computing arithmetic error with a declared bound for a specific circuit, source and stream-length regime. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release
SIM-REAL-WITNESS: Quantifies simulation-to-fabric differences for the same model, input and observable population. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release

SNN-DIVERGENCE-HARNESS: Compares the same network and input across implementations under bit-exact, tolerance or statistical oracles. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release
SPIKE-CALIBRATOR: Measures classifier confidence against correctness under declared signal definitions, shifts and placements. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release

SPIKE-CODEC-BENCH: Measures compression of existing spike trains, comparing payload ratio, distortion, encode/decode latency and memory. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release
SPIKE-ENCODER-CHARACTERISER: Measures the information, spike-rate and latency trade-offs of sensor-to-spike encoders. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release

SPIKE-FORMAT-BRIDGE: Converts event recordings between declared formats and reports every permitted loss rather than hiding timestamp, polarity or side-stream changes. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release

SPIKE-GROUNDTRUTH: Generates reproducible event-vision, audio, sensor and control stimuli with ground truth defined by the generator. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release

g.title: SPIKE-QUALITY-GATE: Checks event data against a named quality policy for timestamp, noise, sensor-health, rate, gap and spatial defects. Design and implementation Licence: Undecided for independent release
